newsitem.title: UK: BT to raise price of calls to mobile systems - paper.
newsitem.headline: BT to raise price of calls to mobile systems - paper.

text.p: The cost of calls from British Telecommunications Plc telephones to mobile systems run by Orange Plc and Mercury Communications' One2One will nearly double, the Telegraph newspaper reported on Thursday.
The Telegraph said BT declined to confirm details of the prices rises but said the rises were in the pipeline "for early next year."

The reason for the increase was that Orange and One2One want to claw back from BT a bigger proportion of revenues for calls that ended up on their networks, the report said. Currently, neither operator is charging BT the full cost of carrying these calls.
The Telegraph said daytime call prices would rise to between 29 pence and 30 pence per minute from 16.7 pence, with off-peak charges climbing to around 20 pence a minute from 9.85 pence.
